title: cornus multinervosa
intro: Cornus multinervosa, commonly known as Japanese dogwood, is a plant species in the family Cornaceae. The health benefits of Cornus multinervosa include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, improve sleep quality, and alleviate anxiety. Bioactive constituents of Cornus multinervosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
